summary: The data sync never waits for hours in silence, and stuck steps reach support the same day.

fixes.title: The data sync never waits in silence
fixes.text: The data sync now says about once a minute what each part waits on. A part stuck for 15 minutes is done again; if it is stuck twice, the step says so and the run goes on.

fixes.title: Stuck steps open a support case
fixes.text: A step that runs far past its usual time without progress now opens a support case, so support acts on it the same day.

fixes.title: Removing old data waits for the sync
fixes.text: While the data sync runs, removing old data waits. It goes on in small portions whenever the sync is not running, so even millions of old rows keep going down.
